summary: New in glirastes/contracts: the view context contract (what the user looks at, declared by the app): entry types and schemas, sanitizeViewContext for untrusted input and resolveViewContextPolicy for the coming viewContext server option. Nothing uses it yet.
howTo: Nothing to do. sanitizeViewContext(input, { declaredTypes, factsSchemas, policy }) keeps up to 8 entries (a record of a declared entity type, a list view selection, or both) and drops invalid entries or fields with content-free reason counts; facts are kept only against a schema with safeParse (Zod or the runtime's JSON schema validator). The chat handler option, the browser registry and the model block follow in later releases.
